# Badge
Atlas Badge v1 — small label/status pill. 6 intents (neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, info) × 3 sizes × 2 states × 2 appearances (default, outline) = 72 total. success/warning/danger/info default use -subtle background + tone text; outline uses transparent background + tone border/text.

USE WHEN
· A status pill in a list row, a count on a tab, or a category tag.

DON'T USE WHEN
· It must be pressed → Button.
· The message needs explanation → Alert.

DO
· Keep the text to one or two words.
· Let the tone carry the meaning: danger means danger.

DON'T
· Use tone colours decoratively.
· Make a plain Badge clickable to fake a button.

PROPERTIES
Variant: neutral | primary | success | warning | danger | info. Appearance: default | outline. Size: sm | md | lg. State: default | disabled.
